Do you need engaging videos for your business plan, ads, or educational purposes? In 2024, there is no need to record real videos, pay for actors, and write scripts. HeyGen is a software for AI video creation. Choose the virtual avatar, write text, add background music, and see the tool crafting a realistic video.

If you're ready to create professional videos, see this review. You'll explore HeyGen pricing and the video generation guide, as well as the tool's pros and cons. Finally, see the alternatives for this AI video generator.

## What is HeyGen AI?

HeyGen is an AI video generator for businesses, creators, managers, and educational institutions. With the help of premade AI characters, it offers easy and quick video generation:

1.  Choose the avatar for personal touch. Choose one of 300 avatars made by HeyGen. Characters differ by gender, nationality, facial expressions, and emotions. This covers diverse needs and target audiences.
2.  Select the language. HeyGen operates in 200+ languages, including English, German, Spanish, French, etc. This helps to create videos for different countries and target markets. All this requires just a few clicks.
3.  Choose the voice clone. AI-generated voices can be friendly, serious, professional, soft, and so on. With unparalleled language localization, you get realistic speech imitation.
4.  Set the background. It can be your PowerPoint presentation, a pre-recorded screen video, or an AI background. Choose what suits your goal. For friendly videos, consider natural backgrounds – offices, nature, etc.
5.  Enter the text. Write the script or let Chat GPT do it. Audio uploads are also available.

Finally, confirm and see what happens. HeyGen crafts high-quality videos in only several minutes. As a result, you get a realistic video where a chosen avatar speaks naturally, using your script. Talking avatars behave like humans, offering a realistic video experience. With the user-friendly platform, even a beginner can create realistic content.

## HeyGen Pricing Plans

Upon registration, choose a pricing plan – one of four options. Let's explore pricing details for better understanding.

### Free Plan

A free plan features the main functions, but you are limited in the number of videos. Each month, you can craft up to 3 videos, each lasting up to 3 minutes. Use up to 60 studio avatars and only one custom avatar – a person you create from scratch. You have access to all languages, the AI video generator, and the editor. The video processing speed is standard. However, advanced features are not included.

This plan is more than enough for learning and beginning your journey. Note that all videos are exported with a watermark.

### Unlock Premium Features

With plaid plans, craft long-form videos, access the fastest video processing, and craft as many videos as you need monthly. There are three paid plans, each with added features:

1.  **Creator plan ($29 per month)**. The video duration here is 5 minutes, and you are not limited to the number of videos. Within this plan, you can create up to 3 instant avatars – these are characters created based on your photos. Faster processing and PDF presentation input are included.
2.  **Team plan ($89 per month)**. Craft unlimited videos with a 60-minute duration. Use premium avatars and export your videos in 4K. The processing is also faster.
3.  **Enterprise plan (customizable pricing plans)**. To access this format, contact the support team. Within this plan, craft multi-scene videos, use auto-captions, create unlimited videos of any format and resolution, and use all possible features of HeyGen.

All users receive multilingual support, but the Creator plan can only reach out via email. Enterprise plans receive personalized assistance. Note that a free trial is absent – to try the tool, simply use the free plan format.

To avoid buying a whole subscription, you can also purchase more credits. This enables some limited features within any subscription type.

## HeyGen for Professional Videos: Pros and Cons

Like any video creation kit, HeyGen has pros and cons. See if the tool suits your expectations or whether you need an alternative.

**Pros**:

*   A library of "how-to videos" for each function;
*   Easy video sharing and uploading;
*   Use a free HeyGen offer to craft content for free;
*   No need for expensive equipment for video filming;
*   An intuitive interface for a content creator;
*   Versatile plans for companies and individuals;
*   No need for technical skills since Heygen offers automatic creation;
*   Unique features on the market of video generation.

**Cons**:

*   Expensive pricing plans;
*   The customer support takes up to several days to respond;
*   Video previewing is limited daily.

## Heygen Positive Reviews

HeyGen has 4.7 stars on **Trustpilot** – that's quite a good status. Among positive reviews, customers praise amazing lip-syncing. With the help of AI, text-to-speech works amazingly. Customers receive realistic videos as if a real person were talking.

The interface is also good. Greg Heaver from Australia says that "a non-tech guy like myself" has easily sorted the interface out. Other users also compare HeyGen to alternatives, emphasizing its ease of use and amazing AI.

## Negative Reviews About Video Creation with HeyGen

However, not everything's perfect. Looking through negative reviews, one can see customer support complaints. It takes up to several days to receive an email response. Within paid plans, the same problem happens.

Another complaint is non-intuitive pricing. Heygen offers free video creation, enabling all the functions. Once you use them, the paywall may appear before the export. ## HeyGen pricing questions

How much does HeyGen cost in 2026? +

HeyGen has a free plan at $0, Creator at $29/month, Pro at $49/month and Business at $149/month. Enterprise is quoted on request. Extra seats on Business cost $20 per seat per month. Checked on heygen.com in September 2026.

Is HeyGen free, and what does the free plan include? +

Yes, there is a permanent free plan. It gives you 3 videos per month of up to 1 minute each, access to Avatar IV, 500+ stock video avatars, 1 custom video avatar and 30+ languages. Exports on the free plan carry a watermark and use standard processing speed.

How do I remove the HeyGen watermark? +

Watermark removal starts on the Creator plan at $29/month. Every paid tier above it (Pro, Business, Enterprise) also exports without a watermark. There is no way to remove it on the free plan.

Does HeyGen charge per seat or per credit? +

Both, depending on the tier. Creator and Pro are single-seat plans with a monthly credit allowance (600 and 1,000 credits). Business includes 1,500 credits and charges $20 per additional seat per month. Credits are consumed by video length and by the features used.

What is the difference between HeyGen Creator and Pro? +

Pro costs $20 more and adds 400 extra credits (1,000 vs 600), 4K export instead of 1080p, faster processing, access to all advanced AI models and customizable monthly usage. Both cap individual videos at 30 minutes.

Does HeyGen offer API access? +

Yes, HeyGen prices its API separately from the subscription plans, so API usage is not covered by your Creator, Pro or Business credits. Check HeyGen’s API pricing page for current rates.

Is Vuela.ai more affordable than HeyGen? +

Vuela.ai starts at $9/month against HeyGen’s $29, and covers a much broader set of tools, not just avatar video. For teams that need video generation, image editing, translation, cloning and API access, Vuela.ai delivers more per dollar. For pure avatar work with a large stock avatar library, HeyGen is the more specialised tool.

What does HeyGen not include that Vuela.ai does? +

Vuela.ai includes tools HeyGen does not have: video cloner, motion transfer, product-to-video, music-to-video, PDF-to-video, 30+ image editing tools, and API access on supported plans.

Can I cancel Vuela.ai at any time? +

Yes. All Vuela.ai plans are cancel-anytime with no lock-in contracts.
